newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Jan aluminum orders best in two years - Spector.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Jan aluminum orders best in two years - Spector.

text.p: January's U.S. aluminum industry mill product orders were at their best since 1994, up 24.2 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis from the same month in 1996, industry analyst Stewart Spector said.
The poundage of can sheet bookings in January was up nearly 13 percent from a year ago, even after taking into account that sheet is now rolled 2 percent thinner, Spector said.
Non-can sheet bookings were also strong, up 29 percent over January 1996, with flat rolled products up 39 percent.
"When combined with can sheet, January's total flat rolled product order rate was equal to 135 percent of the industry's rolling capacity," Spector said.

In January aluminum industry daily orders, on a seasonally adjusted basis, totaled 63.3 million pounds, comprising 28.6 million pounds of sheet, plate and foil, 17.3 million pounds of cansheet, and 17.4 million pounds of other products.
"It is important to note that the strong year to year gains are likely to persist through the first half of this year," Spector added.
First half gains this year will represent an increase in real consumption after last year's destocking by consumers, Spector said.
